physical.fixing: screw-on, M6 cage nuts and screws

configs.description: One FHU-BPS-1U-10 panel as FS ships it, one of the ten in the pack.
configs.name: base

gaps.note: no FS document dimensions how far the plate's folded top and bottom edges reach back; 9.8 is the tool-less family's figure.
gaps.wanted: a side view dimensioned, or a ruler on the part
`attrs.physical.weight-kg` (profile `passive` - see spec/schemas/profiles.yaml) - unlocks the About panel, and comparison against other devices
no bays and no grouped ports to correlate against, so there is nothing to wire yet - group the ports first - unlocks ENTITY-MIB / Redfish correlation and monitoring overlays
a port the DCIM export types as an interface - a placement in a group whose role is a port role, with media and speed it maps - unlocks interfaces on the NetBox / Nautobot device type

chassis.note: the plate is the part: 44 x 482.6 per the specification, one steel plate the full width of the rack with its two mounting ends (the ears) in the same sheet, so the face is drawn at 482.6 with its slots (the owner's rule of 2026-10-09: ears built into the face are part of the face; lint L43 stands down for a body this wide). Behind the middle of the plate its top and bottom edges are folded back into short returns, which is the depth.

color.note: black powder-coated steel, "Color: Black" in the specification; drawn in the shade of the FS cable managers.

depth.note: 9.8: no FS document states the returns' depth for the screw-on blanks. The tool-less steel blanks (FHU-BPSTL) dimension theirs 0.39 in (9.8 mm) and the gallery renders of the two families show returns of the same proportion, so 9.8 is drawn. The 3D body is the plate and its returns as one 9.8-deep box across the full width; the real ends are a single 1 mm sheet.

eia.note: EIA-310 hole positions: the rail holes of each rack unit stand 6.35, 22.225 and 38.1 mm up from its bottom, and the two rails' holes are 465.1 mm apart across the rack. The plate is taken as centred in the rack units it fills, so a hole's height on the plate is its height in the units less half the difference between the units and the plate.

hardware.note: the product page: "Mounting Hardware is Included for Easy Installation" (2U, 4U; the 1U page's description says the same). The cage nuts and screws (render x4) are not drawn; they are not part of the plate.

lifecycle.note: checked 2026-10-09 against what the intake holds: the FS product page for this SKU was live when the intake read it on 2026-10-08, and the FS documentation portal's Accessories tree, read the same day, carries no end-of-sale notice for it. No web search beyond FS's own pages was made.

mark.note: FS prints its mark near the left end of the face (the stencil and every render); it is a logo and is not drawn. Its place is reserved as the region `logo-zone`: on the straight-on gallery render of SKU 72753 (g4), calibrated on the plate at 3.17 px/mm across and 3.20 down, the mark runs x 22.1 to 42.5 and y 16.7 to 26.8. The mounting slots are the check: the same calibration puts the upper left one at x 3.2 to 13.9, against the 3.39 to 14.39 this file draws.

method.note: the FS Blanking Panel Datasheet (portal 2125), FHU-BPS-1U-10 column. Height and width are the specification ("Dimensions (HxW) 44 x 482.6 mm"); the layout of the face is the FS Blanking Panel Visio stencil, master FHU-BPS-1U-10, rendered at 10 px/mm against its 482.6 width, checked against the straight-on gallery render of SKU 72753 (g4) and the dimensioned render (x3); the slot positions are EIA-310's, which both agree with.

packs.note: the datasheet's Package row: 10pcs/pack. FS sells the 1U panel only as this ten-pack, so the model is the pack's SKU and the base configuration is one panel of it.

rear.note: the back of the plate as the rear three-quarter renders (g5) show it: plain, the two returns seen edge-on along its top and bottom between the ends, and the slots through it.

returns.note: the returns run 26.5 to 456.1 across the plate: the straight-on gallery render of SKU 72753 (g4) at 3.18 px/mm puts the return edge 25.8 and 456.7 in from the left end, the stencil's outline notches 27.1 and 457; the mean, made symmetric.

sides.note: the plate's end edge-on at the front, the two returns behind it, and the open channel between them; drawn from the renders' profile, which no document dimensions.

slots.note: 2 slots at each end, 11 x 7 with round ends, centred 8.89 in from each end: FS's dimensioned render (SKU 72753 x3) prints 18.3 in (464.82 mm) between the slot centres across and 1.24 in (31.5 mm) between the 1U plate's two slots, EIA-310's 465.1 and 31.75 to within 0.3. The slot size is the gallery renders' (11.0 x 7.2 on the 1U, 10.6 x 6.8 on the 2U and 4U) and the stencil's (11.4 x 7.1). Heights are EIA's, the top and bottom rail holes of the units the plate fills; the renders put them within 0.5 of those.

thickness.note: 1 mm sheet, drawn as the slots' `vent` depth and the plate edge; FS states the material (SPCC) and not its gauge.

weight.note: the FS Blanking Panel Datasheet: 2.588 kg for the pack of ten, so 0.259 a panel (derived)
